name.description: Shown in the report. Default: the repository folder name.

direction.description: One or two sentences on the intended architecture: context for the story and the decisions.

base.description: Default base ref for `local` (else origin/HEAD, origin/main, origin/master, main, master…).

budget.description: Digest size in characters (default 12000 ≈ 3k tokens). --budget overrides it.

layers.description: Map lanes, drawn top to bottom in this order (entry points first, core last). The order does not decide what may depend on what: [rules] does.

allow.description: Allowed dependency directions. When present, any other edge between layers is a violation.

forbid.description: Always a violation, even when `allow` matches.

same_layer.description: Allow dependencies inside a layer (default true).

name.description: The name the team uses; it labels the box (about 20 characters).

desc.description: One line: what this component owns.

paths.description: Path globs: `*` and `?` stay inside one folder, `**` crosses folders, a plain folder covers everything below it. A file belongs to the component with the most specific match.

imports.description: TypeScript/Python/require specifiers owned by this component outside its paths. `*` matches anything, `.` and `/` included: `billing.*` covers `billing.models.invoice`.

namespaces.description: C# namespaces owned by this component. `*` matches anything, `.` included.

constants.description: Ruby constants owned by this component. `*` matches anything, `::` included.

components.description: The boxes of the map. Aim for 8–20, named the way the team talks about the app.

flows.description: Reference flows: runtime paths the team considers central. An explained flow with the same id is compared with it.

glossary.description: The team's ubiquitous language: term = one-line definition. Name components and flows with these terms; the agent writes the explanation with them.

paths.description: Generated or vendored files: listed apart, never analyzed. Replaces the default list.

tests.description: Test file patterns. Replaces the default list.

description: explain-change configuration (.explain-change.toml at the repository root).
